items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: MORRIS LEY Inaudible) said, Mario, I've got an idea. You don't mind to play with every man.

ctx.x: When you say they, you mean Granz or who brought?

(MORRIS LEY Inaudible) said, Mario, I've got an idea. You don't mind to play with every man. Nobody know every man yet. I said, well, I don't mind. So they brought every man, this tenor player from Paris, I never seen --
